title: SecretMode encrypted envelope v1
description: Transport envelope. Mirrored message metadata is an untrusted routing hint until it is compared with authenticated metadata recovered from the Olm plaintext.

sessionId.description: Untrusted routing mirror. Must exactly match authenticated inner sessionId after decryption.

messageId.description: Untrusted routing mirror. Must exactly match authenticated inner messageId after decryption.

senderDeviceId.description: Untrusted routing mirror. Must exactly match authenticated inner senderDeviceId after decryption.

cryptoHeader.description: Opaque, base64-encoded protocol header. Backend must not parse ratchet internals.

ciphertext.description: End-to-end encrypted payload. Plaintext and authenticated inner metadata never appear here in decoded form.

sequence.description: Untrusted routing mirror. Never advance replay state from this value; compare it to the authenticated inner sequence first.

createdAt.description: Untrusted routing mirror. Must exactly match authenticated inner createdAt if displayed or used for ordering.
